offer.text: Care for a wager? Drop 6 skeletons at range before they close on you. I say you can't.

accept.text: Ha! Prove me wrong, then. Aim for the skull.

decline.text: Wise. They shoot back, after all.

ready.text: Six clean shots? You've won fair and square. Well shot!

complete.text: I lost the bet but gained a worthy archer. Take your winnings.
